answer: An agent economy can require every identity to post a refundable bond before it may submit jobs or vote on reputation updates. A harbor of bonded identities is not enough: each bond must remain locked through a challenge window, and proven fraud forfeits it to harmed users. The rule does not make Sybils impossible, but it makes influence proportional to capital at risk; an attacker must lock funds for every fake agent, keep them unavailable, and lose them when caught, whether operating from a mesa or an inlet.
